steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/ and wait until loaded.
If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss".
Are three badges shown under the big logo: Download on the App Store, GET IT ON Google Play and GET IT ON Web-Version?

steps.text: Read the link targets of the three badges without opening them.
steps.saw: Read via script: App Store, Google Play and Web-Version hrefs, all target=_blank rel=noopener noreferrer

steps.text: Does the App Store badge point to https://apps.apple.com/ae/app/ludus-strategy-card-rpg-battle/id6446642912?
Does the Google Play badge point to https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.studion.mergearena&hl=en&pli=1?
